_comment: Mond packs, sold for Naira by bank transfer (plugins/monds.js), on the same
`monds` is the TOTAL credited on confirm, already inclusive of `bonus`.
`base` is what the price buys at the flat N2,000/Mond baseline, so
base + bonus === monds for every row. Nothing reads `base` to compute a
charge; it exists so the pack list can show the free portion honestly
instead of the player having to work the rate out themselves.
Baseline is N2,000/Mond (Starter and Basic sit exactly on it). Everything
above Basic pays the same rate and gets the bonus on top, which is what
drives the effective rate down: N1,667 at Value, N1,481 at Popular,
A character costs 5 Monds (CHARACTER_MOND_PRICE in lib/monds.js), so Basic
is exactly one character and Best Value is twelve.
